# Identifying the inputs of expansion_fcff_v1

For a fresh extraction, keep a source locator (original document, table, fiscal period, column, units) with each group of observations. Work from consolidated statements and use the most recent restated comparative. Convert JPY millions to billions once. Use fiscal years by their starting calendar year. Work at the precision of the original statement, not rounded highlights. Retain the component amounts behind totals in the evidence ledger.

| Field | Source row and calculation |
|---|---|
| history.sales, ebit | Last three completed years, consolidated profit and loss, 売上高 and 営業利益. |
| history.capex, da | Same years, consolidated cash flows. Positive cash spent on 有形固定資産の取得 and 無形固定資産の取得, summed. For da take 減価償却費 from the operating cash flow reconciliation. Do not include sales of assets or purchases of subsidiaries. |
| history.nwc | Year-end operating balance in the consolidated balance sheet: trade notes and receivables including contract assets + finished goods + work in progress + raw materials and supplies − trade notes and payables. Use the balance, not a cash-flow change. |
| history.roic | Actual consolidated ROIC from the issuer's period-specific performance table, recorded as a decimal. Keep targets separate. |
| periods, normalized_group, segments | Start with the latest presentation's comparable new-organization columns: every reported complete fiscal year and latest full-year forecast, excluding superseded forecasts. Use the same 実力損益推移（営業損益ベース） table for consolidated control and constituent rows. Use the published rounding; keep head-office, business creation and adjustments distinct. |
| base_period, product_sales, growth_targets | Use the fiscal year explicitly specified as denominator of the issuer's product **earnings** multiple. Read the product's revenue for that same year from the issuer product sales table. |
| current, disposal | Use latest issuer full-year revenue, EBIT, D&A and fiscal-end **Net有利子負債残高** forecast from the presentation. From latest interim summary take end-of-period issued less treasury, adjusted for split, not weighted-average shares. Take per-share year-end dividend and disclosed entitlement date. Leave an unannounced payment/ex-date absent. Inspect the base-year annual filing's 事業分離 note for disposed external revenue and *signed* operating profit, and map the adjustment to its comparable segment. Where explicitly disclosed both are required for a continued-operations review. |
| project, plan | The board-approved facility announcement separates land, buildings and equipment, and gives commissioning/ramp dates. For maintenance use latest revised three-year 維持更新投資 and the realized previous-plan comparator. Preserve the separate equity-investment scope of the growth budget. |
| peer_margins | Use the latest **completed annual** audited/reporting year available by the session for each product benchmark. Use the numerator and denominator in their original financial statement currency and units. Prefer the closest disclosed operating segment over a group, and a consolidated company figure for a product specialist. |
| target and peer market data | Use closing auction regular-session price, 15:30 JST. Verify split-adjusted common share units; use latest issuer full-year forecast EPS published by close. Record third-party P/E as a separate observation with its provider, date and EPS basis. |

### Mitsui copper-foil source locators

Open the latest filings and look for revisions before using these November 2026 locators. The [annual filing](https://www.mitsui-kinzoku.com/LinkClick.aspx?fileticket=Kpe%2BA1bTYyE%3D&mid=1060&tabid=159) contains the consolidated statements and 事業分離 note. Use the previous [annual financial tables](https://www.mitsui-kinzoku.com/LinkClick.aspx?fileticket=XPAPBXFZVI0%3D&mid=1060&tabid=159) for older comparable dates. The [interim presentation](https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/57060/140120261107568329.pdf) has the forecast, comparable segments and product sales. Use the [original plan](https://www.mitsui-kinzoku.com/LinkClick.aspx?fileticket=UUc%2B7P6vL4o%3D&mid=1060&tabid=159) and [revised plan](https://www.mitsui-kinzoku.com/LinkClick.aspx?fileticket=Qm2Jc2k%2Bpgo%3D&mid=1060&tabid=144) for realized and revised maintenance/ROIC. For operating peers read JX Information and Communication Materials in the [JX annual results](https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/50160/140120260510521173.pdf) and the consolidated sales and operating profit in [Co-Tech's issuer annual report](https://www.co-tech.com/uploads/images/Finance/114%E5%B9%B4%E5%BA%A6%E5%B9%B4%E5%A0%B1.pdf). JX and Furukawa Electric publish comparable March-year-end EPS forecasts; keep the operating-margin peer set separate from the trading-multiple peer set.


### Raw-row contract for the November 16, 2026 session

For fresh extraction store the following original observations in `financial.json > metadata > filing_rows`. The runner checks them before evaluating the DCF. These are field locators only; independently read every value.

- `core_ebit_oku` is an object keyed 機能材料, 金属, 本社管轄, 事業創造, 調整額, 連結. Copy the twelve numeric cells for each row from slide numbered 26, **実力損益推移 / ■営業利益**. Original unit 億円. The independently read annual FY2025 and current FY2026 values on slide 23 must tie to the FY2025 actual and FY2026 forecast on slide 26. Slide 23 shows the latest forecast immediately before the superseded forecast. Include FY2024 recast from 新組織. Keep the same Japanese row labels in segments; 連結 is the control total.
- `historic_million`, keyed by starting FY as a string, contains `sales,ebit,da,ppe_cash,intangible_cash,receivables,finished,wip,materials,trade_payables,roic_percent`. First ten are JPY millions as printed in the consolidated statements. ROIC is in percentage points. Extract the raw cash purchase lines from the consolidated cash flow statement. Use half-width numeric cells and preserve signed losses.
- Integer share counts `issued_shares,treasury_shares` come from the end-of-interim split-adjusted rows. `product_sales_million` comes from the annual filing, 収益認識関係 / 収益の分解, copper foil, end-customer sales in JPY millions (presentation slides round to 億円). `divested_ebit_million,divested_sales_million` refer to the 事業分離 note, same units, signed EBIT.
- Operating peer IDs `peer_margins[].company` are 5016 (JX, 情報通信材料, annual segment earnings and **segment sales** in the May annual results) and 8358 (Co-Tech, consolidated annual statement). Store period_end (ISO), months, unit (JPY million or TWD thousand) and raw sales/ebit in those units. Use the year most recently completed and reported by the close. Trading peers are JX and [Furukawa Electric](https://www.furukawaelectric.com/release/2026/comm_20261109.html); use the latter's [earnings release](https://www.furukawaelectric.com/ir/library/finalreport/pdf/2027/20261109.pdf). Group diversification limits comparability and is disclosed.
- For the third-party comparison use the dated Kabutan historical valuation row for 5706. For JX and Furukawa use the dated 15:30 Traders Web PER and its displayed EPS when available, with ticker-specific URLs. Always obtain the regular closing price from a second dated quote and record the target and both comparables. A different vendor multiple can be an additional attributed observation; do not replace the standard observation silently.
